merge_space.title: Averaging independently born weights does not degrade a model — it ends it
merge_space.scope: All six independent-pair averages gated exactly zero, at every level. Merges inside a shared-init lineage land in the parent band.

ssm_star.scope: Paired arms: same device, same diet, same seed. The state-space arm also trained 22.6× slower. Booked as a loss, like every other result here.

effective_context.title: Width buys the ability to exploit long context, not local precision
effective_context.scope: Loss at deep positions when the model may see only the last k tokens. The widths are indistinguishable to k=16 and separate steadily after it.
effective_context.xlabel: context the model may see, k (tokens)
effective_context.fence: PRE-REG KEFF-PROBE-1 · 400 fixed rows · Mac CPU · no training required

loss_floor.title: The training floor walks down with width — and stops nowhere near the corpus limit
loss_floor.scope: Fresh births on one warm diet, fp32. Eight times the width buys roughly one token of effective context.
